messages:
jia: bringing up Orion-7b (hf/orion-7b-native). basic load + int4 quant looked fine but we see embed mismatch vs reference on long contexts. deploying test harness now.

mike: saw that, pushed a quick perf run — int4 logits mostly aligned but embeddings differ around token ids > 32000. here's failing case:
```
input: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog... (truncated)"
ref_embed[12][:8] = [0.123, -0.045, 0.091, -0.002, 0.004, 0.001, -0.008, 0.012]
our_embed[12][:8] = [0.031, -0.210, 0.078, 0.021, -0.011, 0.105, 0.033, -0.090]
```

emma: could be tokenizer mapping? model was exported with custom vocab / bpe merges. Did you run NFKC normalization? we had a similar offset with the nhx conversion last quarter.

jia: ran tokenized sequences: token ids align for first ~2k tokens, diverge when emojis / zero-width joiners appear. example at char idx 1288: ref=50234 our=12510.

luca: that smells like vocab aliasing / overflow. Orion reportedly keeps token ids > 65535 for specials? If theres wraparound during an int16 -> int8 cast it can alias. also check rotary frequency scaling — mismatch in positional rotates shows as drift in long context.

mike: i instrumented kv cache read: kv keys at step 512 show consistent head perm but angle seems shifted. dump attached:
```
head0_rotary_phase[508:512] = [0.12, 0.15, 0.17, 0.19]
ref_head0_rotary_phase = [1.379, 1.402, 1.425, 1.448]
```

jia: interesting — export pipeline applies per-head scaling *after* quantization. maybe per-head multiplier missing. conversion command we used:
`python convert.py --from hf --to redwood --quant int4 --per_channel_scale`

emma: try `--save-rotary-params --rotary-preserve-order`. in previous cases ordering loss caused phase divide by ~11.

luca: also check embedding matrix row-order: some exporters pack embeddings as (vocab, dim) vs (dim, vocab) for performance. a transpose bug shows exactly like your numbers.

mike: quick tests: transposed embeddings -> our vectors align with ref for first 1k tokens, but kvphase still off. hypothesis: tokenizer maps some Unicode sequences to masked sentinel tokens which changed prefix caching alignment.

jia: rolling an A/B: keep current quant+convert vs convert with `--preserve-norm --rotary-order --transpose-embed`. will run Evals suite (lm+long-context) and post diffs.

infra-bot: deployment pipeline: started job build/convert/2782109876-run1, logs at https://ci.internal/redwood/2782109876

emma: thanks. if A wins we'll update conversion docs and add a short test (token id parity + rotary smoke) to the converter CI.

mike: update: after transpose+preserve-rotary run, embed cosine sim >0.98 for sample set, perplexity matches ref on 2k context. leaving run to finish.

jia: nice. leaving notes: root causes combined: embedding transpose + lost rotary-per-head scaling + tokenizer NFKC mismatch. next steps: add tokenizer parity check, ensure convert flags default to preserve-rotary, and add a small quant-smoke test harness in eng-ml.

luca: I'll open a tiny RFC for default convert flag changes and link to eval diffs.

mike: :thumbsup:
